text:
Hydrogen is used as a fuel in rockets and is also used in hydrogen fuel cells.
Which statements are correct?
1
Both uses produce water vapour.
2
Burning hydrogen produces polluting gases.
3
A fuel cell produces electricity.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 3 only
C
1 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry

content.html: Hydrogen is used as a fuel in rockets and is also used in hydrogen fuel cells.
content.text: Hydrogen is used as a fuel in rockets and is also used in hydrogen fuel cells.

content.html: Both uses produce water vapour. Burning hydrogen produces polluting gases. A fuel cell produces electricity.
